title: Displacement
text: Displacement is the integral of velocity v(t). Total distance traveled is the integral of the speed $$|v\left(t\right)|$$.

title: Split at $$t=3$$
text: The graph of $$|2t-6|$$ on [0,6] is two triangles, each with base $$3$$ and height $$6$$. Each has area $$9$$, so the distance is $$18$$.
